youtube.title: It's Not Just the Sea
youtube.caption:
A closer Moon pulls on solid ground too, not only the oceans. A thought experiment about Earth's crust flexing.

The ground has tides as well as the sea.

Part 6 of 8. Full video on YouTube: How Close Can the Moon Get Before It Breaks?

Thought experiment: the Moon is not coming closer. Narration is a synthetic voice (AI); the pictures are AI-assisted paintings and code-rendered.
